prompt_en: Create one complex but single-frame photoreal scene: a visible physical barrier breakthrough event in a flooded seed-vault corridor. An adult woman guided only by the visible appearance in the provided portrait, with long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and broadly comparable facial proportions, wears a charcoal rescue suit. She drives a compact steel hydraulic ram straight into a resisting frost-white laminated resin bulkhead while her face and upper body stay readable. The frost-white laminated resin bulkhead proves that a finite-thickness barrier retains intact resistant material around one fresh breach. The woman and steel hydraulic ram make one subject object or force vector aligns directly with the same barrier contact point. Across the laminated resin, fresh cracks tearing shear or plastic deformation radiates from that localized contact point under visible load. At the decisive midpoint, a newly opened aperture carries the same subject object or displaced material across the former boundary in one continuous passage. Her ram, leading shoulder, and one knee occupy that coherent passage. Translucent debris dust fluid fragments or deformation traces remain localized along the contact-to-passage path beside the aperture. Use a low three-quarter portrait centered on the approach-contact-passage axis. Cool emergency backlight shines through the breach while warm work light reveals her face, wet fabric, bent resin layers, and concentrated condensation spray with documentary realism.
